text.tspan: Bone 45 · Ink 30 · Sand 12 · Rose 8 · Stone 3 · Blush 2 — Rose is a spark, never a flood.
Secondary palettes for client work and campaigns. The core palette always owns the NxA page; these dress the content.
Persian food, Ava’s kitchen, warm F&B
Hotels, exteriors, golden hour, Dubai light
RULE: THE LOGO’S × STAYS DAMASK ROSE OR INK IN EVERY PALETTE.
The suit. One line per layout,
Headlines: sentence case, max 6 words, Syne.
One serif italic line per layout — never two.
Body: Manrope Regular, 45–75 characters a line.
Labels: Manrope Bold caps, wide tracking.
Never stretch, outline or shadow type.
IBM Plex Sans Arabic · Vazirmatn — for bilingual posts and Persian food stories.
Fraunces + Inter — Warmer, bookish. For hotels and fine dining.
Playfair Display + Space Grotesk — Magazine feel. For fashion and styling.
Unbounded + Manrope — Louder, techier. For launches and events.
Rose lines on Ink. Story backgrounds, end cards.
A nod to mashrabiya screens. Packaging, proposals.
Ink ×s, every seventh in Rose. Stickers, tissue paper.
Wide Bone bands on Rose. Announcements, launches.
Patterns dress our own surfaces — never behind client photos or food. Full-size swatches are in /patterns.
PICK THE MOOD FROM THE CONTENT, NOT FROM THE CALENDAR. ONE MOOD PER POST; STORIES MAY CHANGE MOOD PER FRAME.
Symmetry, one strong line, natural light
The making, not just the made
Steam, texture, a real bite taken
Staff and owners, candid, never stock
Navid’s frame: light first, lines at 35°, calm symmetry, space to breathe. Ava’s frame: life, hands, food in motion, warmth.
Grade: true colour, warm neutrals, soft Ink shadows. No heavy filters, no fake HDR, no AI-generated images — ever.
Open on the result — the finished plate, the lit room.
The words on screen match the words spoken.
On camera, talking to one person.
Warm, quick, real. Never read off a phone.
Behind the camera. Seen through hands,
Always burned in: Manrope Bold, Bone on Ink
The × on Ink, 1 second, no music sting.
Crop marks around a hero shot —
Photo, film & styling for Dubai’s independent places.
Avatar: the Rose × on Ink. Link: one booking link, never a link list.
Handle: @nxa.studio (to confirm — check it is free first).
Rose appears in one tile per row, max.
No puzzle grids — each post stands alone.
Rules: one message per post · the × sign-off only, never the full logo on content · one Rose element per post.
Highlight covers: one line icon, mood colours, no text inside the circle.
Stories: text in the top 60%, stickers in the safe middle,
the × in the corner. Change mood per frame, keep fonts fixed.
Show the process — hands, set-ups, light
Name the people behind every shoot
Get client approval before posting their work
Write alt text for every image
Respect UAE content rules and guests’ privacy
No AI faces, AI voices or cloned voices
No AI-generated food, spaces or people as our work
No fake numbers, fake urgency or fake reviews
No naming or mocking other agencies
No posting client work before they publish
AI may help us plan, draft captions and edit. It never replaces the camera. Every portfolio image is a real shoot.
